scope: Read-only mechanical audit of inherited atomic quotient and saved trajectories; no nuclear-rate admission

source_identity.note: The current atomic source has a documented old-receipt exception for two retained profile cases in run.py:226-240. New work must read, not rewrite, inherited raw results. These hashes identify current source bytes only; no trajectory corpus rehash was performed.

code_paths.finding: T is a declared isotope with two census charge names but abundance() initializes its elemental yield to exactly zero; D has 2.5e-5 before baryon normalization.
The integrated chemistry is nine shared conditional H/He/Li fractions; W excludes T and n. The nine initial fractions have no isotope inventory variable.

matrices()/point() contain atomic photoionization/recombination only. lift() inserts literal zeros for both n and T at every sample; other isotope charge censuses are fixed yield times shared conditional fractions.
Reference mode duplicates H1/D, He3/He4, Li6/Li7 charge fractions only; no n or T component.
Coupled initializes transport plus 9 or 18 conditional fractions and optical depth. RHS contains no D(D,p)T or T decay source.
Diagnostics save cosmological H, nB, elapsed time, and prescribed T. Isotopic census does not feed nuclear energy/electron feedback.
257 samples of integrated state, conditional fractions, lifted census, and diagnostics are saved to per-case NPZ; old census T columns inherit lift() literal zeros.

Channel 14 D(D,p)T is listed but unimplemented, with initial-T-zero specifically not proving no production. Identical D reactants require the 1/2 event factor, and rate/charge mapping/decay need separate physical decisions.

saved_inventory.avoid_pickle: The abundances member is object dtype. Schema checks and postprocessing can read all required arrays using np.load(..., allow_pickle=False), without reading abundances.

offline_tracer_feasibility.inputs: At each sample n_D[cm^-3] = (nB_m3/1e6)*(census[D_0]+census[D_1]); T_K, H_per_s, elapsed_s and x are directly available. D_0 and D_1 remain available if the physical contract chooses charge-specific branching.
offline_tracer_feasibility.event_source: The frozen conditional bare-ion model uses D_1 only: in SI s_DDp=0.5*nB_m3*(census[D_1])^2*k_DDp, with k in m^3/s. An all-D same-kernel comparator substitutes D_0+D_1; it does not bound neutral or screened physical channels. The source per x is s/H.
offline_tracer_feasibility.limits: An offline tracer follows frozen atomic/cosmological trajectories and cannot claim self-consistent depletion, daughter-ion feedback, nuclear heat, or a full 19-channel network. Decay, rate validity, ionic product mapping, and numerical interpolation must follow the separately frozen physical contract.

reproducible_inspection: rg -n 'def abundance|def lift|def matrices|def point|def rhs|def run_case|np.savez_compressed' research/rei_isotope_quotient_pilot_20261022/pilot/code/{atomic_quotient.py,run.py}
Use numpy.load(path, allow_pickle=False) on all results/*.npz, check listed shapes/keys, finite input columns, and count_nonzero(census[:,T_0/T_1]) == 0; omit the object-valued abundances member.
conclusion: Old T=0 is structurally enforced by absent initial inventory and absent source/decay dynamics, then literal-zero census lift. It is not a prediction that D(D,p)T is physically zero.
